messages:
Sam (SRE): incident-bot: PagerDuty PDR-99102 fired: canary healthchecks failing in us-central1
Maya (Eng): seeing consistent 502/503 on /health after ~30s under low traffic
pd-bot: PagerDuty incident PDR-99102 triggered (HIGH) — service: inference-edge-canary — symptom: canary 5xx spike
Sam (SRE): acked the page. joining the bridge :headphones:
incident-bot: Canary alert: 8/16 pods failing liveness, several CrashLoopBackOff
OpsBot: kube-scheduler: nodes in us-central1 had an automated kernel patch rollout last night
Leo (ProdEng): did v3.4.2 change any shared libs or runtime paths? could be a binary/ABI mismatch
Maya (Eng): we moved tokenizer path to /opt/mlbundle/3.0 in v3.4.2; app expects v3.0 at startup
Sam (SRE): grabbing logs from a failing pod now:
```
E0316 05:22:41.789012 1 http_server.cc:101] upstream read timeout
ERROR tokenizer: version mismatch, expected 3.0 found 2.9
```
Sam (SRE): yep — node image skew. some nodes still have mlbundle 2.9, others 3.0 -> init errors
Maya (Eng): ABI mismatch explains CrashLoopBackOff on tokenizer init
Sam (SRE): mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic off canary 2) scale canary to 0 3) pause rollout 4) reconcile node images
Maya (Eng): commands executed (prod-admin):
```
kubectl patch deployment/inference-edge-canary -n inference -p '{"spec":{"replicas":0}}'
kubectl annotate namespace inference rollout-paused=true --overwrite
```
Sam (SRE): pd-bot: updating PD incident with mitigation steps and customer-impact note
pd-bot: PagerDuty PDR-99102 updated: acknowledged; note added
Sam (SRE): updating traffic routing to stable
incident-bot: Traffic split updated: canary 0% -> stable 100%
Leo (ProdEng): kicking off node image reconcile (rolling) across us-central1 via salt-run
Maya (Eng): ETA ~10m for image sync; will keep canary at 0 until nodes report mlbundle 3.0
Sam (SRE): customer impact summary: intermittent 502/503 for ~0.6% of requests in us-central1, isolated to canary node pool; no data loss; CSM notified
Rae (CSM): notifying affected customers with interim status and ETA
pd-bot: PagerDuty escalation: second-level oncall alerted due to HIGH severity
Nina (Oncall-2): acknowledged PDR-99102 — ready for handoff if needed
Sam (SRE): node reconcile status: 5/8 nodes synced
Maya (Eng): re-pulled tokenizer artifact and ensured bundle v3.0 on new container image; scaling canary to 2
Sam (SRE): canary pods booting; healthchecks pending
incident-bot: canary pods: READY 2/2, liveness checks passed
Maya (Eng): startup logs show:
```
INFO tokenizer loaded v3.0 path=/opt/mlbundle/3.0
INFO edge-proxy listening on 8080
```
Sam (SRE): reintroducing 5% traffic to canary for validation; monitoring p99 latency and error rate closely
incident-bot: Traffic split updated: stable 95% -> canary 5%
Leo (ProdEng): monitoring window 15m. if no regressions we continue rollout
Sam (SRE): PD note updated: diversion, node reconcile, canary restart executed; monitoring in progress
pd-bot: PagerDuty PDR-99102 resolved by Sam (SRE)
Sam (SRE): postmortem stub: root cause = partial node-image rollback during infra patch causing mlbundle version skew. Resolution = divert + reimage + canary validate. Remediations: add preflight node-image/version check, gate rollouts on homogeneous node images, improve infra patch process
Maya (Eng): filing PR now to add preflight check into the rollout pipeline
Leo (ProdEng): will add health gating to canary controller to detect mixed node images
Rae (CSM): will send a consolidated customer-facing summary tomorrow morning
Nina (Oncall-2): accepting morning handoff for regression run; leaving note on oncall board
Sam (SRE): closing thread. severity=high; customer-impact=limited; actions logged and owners assigned
